What vendor/bindgen.py couldn't declare in PHI, and why:

struct VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR: a bitfield
struct VkAccelerationStructureMatrixMotionInstanceNV: a bitfield
struct VkAccelerationStructureSRTMotionInstanceNV: a bitfield
struct VkClusterAccelerationStructureGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlagsNV: a bitfield
struct VkClusterAccelerationStructureBuildTriangleClusterInfoNV: a bitfield
struct VkClusterAccelerationStructureBuildTriangleClusterTemplateInfoNV: a bitfield
struct VkClusterAccelerationStructureInstantiateClusterInfoNV: a bitfield
struct VkAccelerationStructureGeometryDataKHR: a union whose size differs between systems in a way PHI's types don't follow ([(64, 8), (64, 8), (56, 8)])
struct VkAccelerationStructureGeometryKHR: it has a VkAccelerationStructureGeometryDataKHR in it, which is held by its address only
#define VK_WHOLE_SIZE: 18446744073709551615 is past 32 bits, which a PHI constant isn't yet
